Hi Alice — thanks for the request. Below is a concise, customer-facing assurance plus technical retention/purge nuance we typically provide for EU/residency tenants. I've attached a signed attestation and our internal erase playbook (redacted) for your legal team.

Attestation (summary):
- Redwood Inference does not use customer inference text, attachments, or generated content to train, fine-tune, or evaluate Redwood-hosted models, research datasets, or any derivative model artifacts unless the customer has provided explicit, written opt-in via contract or a mutually-signed data-sharing agreement.

Standard retention & deletion behaviors (operational summary):
- Inference request path: request payloads (customer inputs) are processed in-memory and the KV cache is ephemeral by design. By default:
  • Short-term operational logs (request metadata, traces, error logs): 30 days.
  • Debug snapshots (when captured for troubleshooting): retained up to 90 days unless customer requests earlier deletion. Snapshots are labeled with tenant metadata and are removed by the purge workflow on TTL expiry.
  • Backups and disaster-recovery snapshots: retained up to 365 days for resilience; these are encrypted and segregated by region.

Edge cases & carveouts:
- Legal hold: if a customer requires preservation for litigation, we will retain data per an agreed legal hold and follow the subpoenas/processes documented in contract.
- Debugging window exceedance: in very rare cases (eg. high-severity incident rollback), debug artifacts may be persisted longer for incident remediation; such cases are documented and limited to a small subset of snapshots.

Erase/tombstone workflow (tenant-level erase request):
1) Tombstone: within 24 hours we mark tenant records as tombstoned across primary stores and routing layers (logical deletion).
2) Purge job: asynchronous purge jobs run daily; full purge across primary stores occurs within 7 days after tombstoning in normal operations.
3) Snapshot/backups purge: the purge of backups and DR snapshots is scheduled on the next backup maintenance window and completes within 30–90 days depending on the backup retention policy and the storage provider's lifecycle (we provide accelerated purge as part of enterprise contracts).
4) Final immutable backup retention: if immutable retention/archival policies apply (e.g., regulatory archive with multi-tenant provider constraints), we coordinate with customers on an accelerated removal plan — typically completed within 90 days after request once contractual steps are agreed.

Proof & auditability:
- We can provide an attestation document (attached) and a timebound audit log export that shows tombstone and purge job ids. For enterprise customers we can also provide per-request deletion receipts for the erase event.

Security & verification notes:
- No customer data is pulled into research or training pipelines. Research datasets are curated from public sources and opt-in partners only, on isolated systems.
- All data at rest is encrypted with KMS; cross-region transfers are logged and subject to our access controls and change-management process.

Attachments included: no_train_attestation_v1.pdf (customer attestation), erase_playbook_v2.pdf (redacted internal playbook).

If you'd like, we can produce a short contract addendum with the accelerated purge SLA and a clause explicitly prohibiting inclusion of your inference data in training.

Regards,
